title: Consolidate insight surface: define minimal cards + fallback contract
creator: Priya Desai
description: Goal: Reduce Console observability surface to a minimal, production-viable set of insight cards and tracing primitives so we can ship a stable alpha with predictable cost and telemetry retention. This ticket defines the scope-cuts, the behavioral contract for degraded modes, and concrete acceptance criteria for QA and launch. Rationale: current feature surface is over-indexed on breadth (many card types and deep traces) which increases implementation effort, telemetry costs, and rollout risk. We need a compact feature contract that preserves core user value: per-route latency & cost, error rates, and simple trace sampling for root-cause investigation.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Deck contains no more than 4 insight cards for alpha: Route Latency (P95), Token Cost Breakdown, Error Rate (5xx), and Throughput (req/s)
A2: Each card renders within 300ms server-side for the default 30-day slice with pagination disabled; front-end skeleton shows in 200ms on 3G simulated network
A3: Tracing shows sampled spans for 1% of requests by default and includes an expand-to-full-trace link that falls back to a short summary when detailed spans are unavailable
A4: Cost breakdown card uses cached prefix KV for heavy routes to avoid full recompute; cache TTL default 15 minutes and must surface cache freshness in UI
A5: All routes have an opt-out "lite mode" that replaces heavy tiles with compact summaries when system-wide cost flag is active
A6: Rollout plan defined: 10% internal beta -> 50% canary -> 100% gradual over 48 hours with automatic rollback if error delta > 0.5% or P95 increases by > 20%
A7: Acceptance tests included: fixture for synthetic workload to validate P95, integration test for cost delta calculations, UX smoke tests for degraded/fallback modes
decisions: D1: Cut: remove per-token heatmap card from alpha — preserves cost card that aggregates tokens by route instead
D2: Keep: tracing lightweight sample + summary link rather than full span store to avoid early storage cost
D3: Trade-off: standardize on single-time-window (30d) for alpha to simplify queries; allow time-window expansion in later releases
D4: Implementation: prioritize server-side aggregated endpoints (single SQL/OLAP job) over client stitching to reduce CPU spikes
updates: 2026-03-02: Initial draft PRD posted and discussed in PM sync; engineering asked to quantify query cost for token breakdown
2026-03-04: Eng provided cost model estimates; recommended cache-first approach and 15m TTL (linked in docs)
2026-03-06: Design produced compact card mocks and a 'lite mode' compact summary pattern; UX asked for accessible color palette
2026-03-09: Security review triage completed — no data-sensitivity blocker for aggregated cards; noted need for KMS audit during private deployments
2026-03-10: Submitted for design & eng review; awaiting sign-off from Sofia (design) and Miguel (serving runtime)
qa_notes: Provide synthetic traffic runner that emits route names and token sizes. Run acceptance suite against a staging cluster with 30-day synthetic data snapshot. Validate fallback behavior by toggling cost-flag in runtime config and asserting UI shows compact summaries within 2 minutes.
implementation_notes: Eng should implement server-side aggregation endpoint exposed as /alpha/insights/summary. Use existing KV prefix cache library. Instrument per-card telemetry events (rendered, stale_cache, fallback_engaged). Add feature flag 'insights.alpha_lite_mode' for rollout. Coordinate with infra for query budget limits.
risks: R1: Underestimating query cost for token breakdown could exhaust OLAP budget; mitigated by cache and single-time-window
R2: UX regressions if compact summaries hide critical signals — mitigated via internal beta with power users
R3: Trace sampling at 1% may miss rare high-severity errors — mitigation: targeted increase to 5% for erroring routes
